notes: Access tier 1 (direct HTTP) worked throughout; no Playwright/Claude-in-Chrome needed. robots.txt (https://www.procook.co.uk/robots.txt) has no Claude-specific disallow (explicitly allows 'Claude-User'), so no policy_opt_out. Cloudflare intermittently issued 403/'Just a moment' challenges on rapid-fire requests without a Referer header; adding 'Referer: https://www.procook.co.uk/' and spacing requests out resolved this, so 403s were retried before being treated as real absence. Main mega-menu is fully server-rendered (no JS needed) and was enumerated completely: top-level nav is only New In / Electricals / Cookware and Bakeware / Knives & Scissors / Tableware & Dining / Drinkware / Kitchen Accessories / Sale & Offers -- there is no standalone Christmas/Easter/Valentine's/Diwali/Thanksgiving/New Year/Mother's or Father's Day nav node anywhere in the primary taxonomy. The only seasonal-named live nav link is 'Halloween 3 for £10' under Sale & Offers > Offers. Site search (Algolia, index 'websearch_production', public search-only key found in page meta tags) was queried directly via HTTP to cross-check for hidden/unlinked category pages: 'christmas' (417 hits), 'easter' (386), 'halloween' (220), 'valentine' (27), 'new year' (349), "father's day" (340), "mother's day" (13), 'diwali' (0), 'thanksgiving' (0) -- confirmed non-default/discriminating (a nonsense query returned 0). A facet aggregation on the product catalog's internal 'categories' taxonomy field (maxValuesPerFacet up to 1000) surfaced an extensive set of Christmas/Halloween/Easter/Valentine's/Mother's Day facet values (e.g. 'Christmas' 170 products, 'Christmas > Shop all Christmas gifting' 95, 'Sale & Offers > Shop all Halloween offers' 197, 'Cookware & Bakeware > Easter baking' 25, 'Sale & Offers > Valentine's Day Gifts' 9, 'Sale & Offers > Mother's Day gifts' 13, etc.) -- these are internal merchandising tags, not proof of a live navigable category, so each candidate slug was resolved and content-verified individually per the task's explicit instruction to sample actual product lists rather than trust the holiday name alone. Resolved and inspected (breadcrumb + full product list via the page's Livewire wire:snapshot JSON, which carries an exact server-computed totalProducts count): (1) /shop/special-offers/halloween-3-for-10 (title 'Halloween Cooking Essentials', breadcrumb Sale & Offers > 'Halloween 3 for £10', 7 products) -- ALL 7 products are explicitly Halloween-named/shaped (Halloween Cookie Cutter Set, Halloween Cookie Cutters, Halloween Pumpkin Ice Cube Mould, Halloween Pumpkin Silicone Chocolate Mould, Halloween Bat Silicone Chocolate Mould, Halloween Shaped Silicone Mould, Halloween Pumpkin Carving Set) -- passes content verification, INCLUDED (flagged for review since it sits under a 'Sale & Offers' bundle-pricing URL rather than a dedicated Halloween nav node). Every other seasonal-named candidate found failed content verification (generic, non-occasion-specific products merely curated under a seasonal marketing label) and was EXCLUDED: /shop/special-offers/mothers-day-gifts (13 products: wine glasses, bread maker, espresso machine, air fryer, cake stand, hand mixer, milk frother -- none Mother's-Day-specific); /shop/special-offers/valentines-day-gifts-for-her (7 products: coupe glass, ice cream maker, wine glasses, coffee machine, mugs, sparkling water maker, milk frother -- none Valentine's-specific); /shop/special-offers/valentines-day-gifts (7 products: milk frother, coffee machine, tumbler, espresso machine, gin glass, trifle bowl, steak knives -- none Valentine's-specific); /shop/special-offers/christmas-gifts-for-couples (11 products: espresso machine, pizza oven air fryer, saucepan set, steak knives, panini press, knife set, coffee machine, cocktail glass, air fryer -- none Christmas-themed); /shop/special-offers/20-off-top-10-christmas-gifts (6 products: milk frother, knife set, coffee machine, pizza oven, stand mixer, cafetiere set -- none Christmas-themed, and the 'X% off' framing itself is a discount-campaign page per the shared marketing exclusions); /shop/cookware-and-bakeware/easter-baking (19 products: only 'Easter Cookie Cutter Set' is occasion-specific, the rest are generic bakeware -- hand mixer, cake tester, flour sifter, mixing bowls, cake tins, baking sheet, cooling items -- fails verification); /shop/cookware-and-bakeware/halloween-baking (4 products: silicone cupcake cases, silicone muffin cases, cooling rack, cake slice -- zero Halloween-themed items despite the URL/breadcrumb, fails verification); /shop/tableware-dining/a-magical-christmas-table (8 products: neutral/sage-green cutlery, table runner, placemats, dinner set -- generic tableware styled 'for Christmas', no festive motifs, fails verification); /shop/special-offers/roasting-and-carving (28 products: roasting tins, carving knives, meat thermometers -- tagged 'Christmas' internally in the facet data but the live breadcrumb/title carries no holiday branding at all, generic year-round roast-dinner equipment, fails verification -- classic seasonal-product-type-in-a-normal-category trap per rules §5/§6). Attempted but not resolvable as live pages (404, including after Referer/retry): /shop/christmas, /shop/special-offers/christmas, /shop/special-offers/shop-all-christmas-offers, /shop/special-offers/shop-all-christmas-gifting, /shop/special-offers/gifts-for-coffee-lovers, /shop/special-offers/gifts-for-foodies, /shop/special-offers/christmas-table-decorations, /shop/special-offers/stocking-fillers, /shop/tableware-dining/christmas-table-decorations, /shop/special-offers/valentines-day-gifts-for-him, /shop/cookware-and-bakeware/christmas-baking -- these correspond to internal facet tags (e.g. 'Christmas > Christmas baking', 'Christmas > Stocking fillers', 'Christmas > Gifts for coffee lovers') with no currently live PLP URL, most plausibly because ProCook activates its full seasonal storefront closer to each holiday (checked 2026-09-04, i.e. ~7 weeks before Halloween and ~3.5 months before Christmas) -- absence recorded, not fabricated. sitemap.xml returned a Cloudflare block page and was not usable for discovery; nav + Algolia facet enumeration + direct slug resolution + content sampling were used instead and are considered sufficient given the small, fully-enumerated 8-item primary nav. No Diwali, Thanksgiving, New Year, Eid, or other Indian-festival category exists in either nav or the product-facet taxonomy (0 Algolia hits for 'diwali' and 'thanksgiving'; 'new year' and "father's day" hits were pure fuzzy-match noise against unrelated facets like 'New In'/'New lower price', confirmed by inspecting their category facet breakdowns, which show no New Year or Father's Day facet value at all).
